split.warning: Every eighth original image in natural numeric filename order, starting index 0. SfM uses all 263 frames. Novel-view interpolation with known SfM cameras; not unseen-camera reconstruction or official Tanks & Temples geometry evaluation.

independent_consumer.scoring: Worker and independent_unclamped use raw float RGB; independent_macro_psnr and displayed PNG use RGB clamped to [0,1]. Compare identical definitions.
independent_consumer.first_consumer_attempt: consumer.result.json: failed clamped-vs-unclamped comparison; retained along with visuals/
independent_consumer.independence: Independent PLY loader/camera assembly; same gsplat rasterization engine

original_comparisons.note: Raw original JPEG against undistorted render; geometric warp differs. Metrics and pixel comparisons use the separate M10 reference sheets.

comparison_visuals.display_semantics: Unmodified reference and independently rendered RGB tiles; resized for sheets only. Full-size per-view comparisons preserved.

visual_review.finding: Best measured and visually improved of the three completed Ignatius fits, with substantial remaining background/water limitations. Not pristine reconstruction or general benchmark acceptance.
improvements: Flower beds, lawn and distant facade details are clearer than 7k across the six-view sheets.
Large bright green/yellow upper-right splat in the 7k first view is strongly reduced.
Statue contour, folds and base remain recognizable and aligned; more fine structure than 7k.
remaining: Water/reflections and pale fountain paving remain smeared; some bright stone highlights look washed out.
Foliage, sky boundaries and distant building windows retain blur, streaks and small floating/speckled elements.
First-view upper boundary still contains a dark elongated floating band and tree/sky speckle; not all floaters removed.
Small holes/speckles and lost thin detail persist around flower bed, bench and foliage; distant person from the first source view is not faithfully represented.
visual_review.poses: No gross doubled statue, collapsed shape, flipped view or major silhouette displacement observed in the six inspected views. Subtle camera/photometric error is not ruled out.
visual_review.colors: Broad bronze/green/stone colors are plausible; local highlights, grass/foliage textures and thin details differ.
comparison_limits: Metrics use exactly identical undistorted M10 target pixels.
Raw JPEG comparison is for visual context; it has the original lens distortion and different display warp.
Held-out images participated in SfM but not Gaussian optimization.
One seed, factor 2 and one horizon; same gsplat renderer behind independent PLY loader/camera assembly.
visual_review.next_experiment: Keep 30k as the current Ignatius quality reference. For efficiency/quality, compare one explicit MCMC capped-Gaussian or AbsGrad setting on this exact M10/split before committing to full-resolution or new-scene training; no such run was launched.

gpu_before.meaning: Instant whole-device MiB memory and utilization percent, includes other applications; not a per-stage peak.

verification.prior_ruff_full: Only existing E501 registry.py:52; no source changes in this experiment.
verification.runtime_checks: Fresh training plan and worker kernel/backward/optimizer capability checks, input validation and final PLY/consumer validation.

consumer_scoring_diagnosis.cause: External comparison helper compared clamped float RGB PSNR with raw float RGB worker PSNR. The gap at 30k is 0.020111 dB, exceeding its 0.02 guard; the 7k gap was smaller. PLY parameter equality and first-view render checks passed before the macro guard.
consumer_scoring_diagnosis.change: Separate raw and clamped scores in a new helper; compare raw with raw using the original tolerance; leave both original helper and failed evidence unchanged.

gpu_during_refinement.meaning: Instant whole-device sample during refinement, not isolated utilization/memory peak.
